items.title: Meraas awards Dh1bn contract for Nad Al Sheba Gardens Phase 7 villas
items.summary: Dubai Holding Real Estate's Meraas awarded GCC Contracting a near-Dh1bn contract for Phase 7 of Nad Al Sheba Gardens. The phase adds 272 homes: 130 villas of four to seven bedrooms and 142 three-bedroom townhouses, with completion targeted for Q2 2028.

items.title: Qatar lines up $61bn infrastructure and real estate pipeline over five years
items.summary: Qatar expects to award about $38.5bn of infrastructure projects, including PPPs, over the next five years, plus a $22.5bn real estate and hospitality pipeline for private investors. It also set up Doha Investment, a platform to manage QIA's domestic portfolio and attract foreign capital.

items.title: Eagle Hills signs $12bn deal for Maldives Waterfront and Marina at Ras Male
items.summary: Abu Dhabi's Eagle Hills, chaired by Mohamed Alabbar, signed a $12bn agreement with the Maldives government to develop Ras Male on about 1,100 hectares of reclaimed land, 17 minutes from Male. Plans include around 65,000 homes, hotels, branded residences and a marina, with 54,000+ jobs and 99-year leaseholds.

items.title: ROSHN and TMG Saudi ink preliminary deal for 55,000-home Riyadh project
items.summary: PIF-owned ROSHN and TMG Saudi signed a preliminary agreement for a mixed-use Riyadh community of more than 55,000 homes, following a June 2026 MoU. TMG Saudi will hold 51% and ROSHN 49%; the scheme includes retail, hospitality, healthcare and education. Value and timeline were not disclosed.

items.title: Aldar-Mubadala JV buys Masdar City Square for Dh918m
items.summary: The Aldar-Mubadala joint venture acquired Masdar City Square, a commercial complex in Abu Dhabi, for Dh918m ($250m). The deal lifts the JV's Masdar City portfolio of commercial and residential income-producing assets to about Dh4.7bn.

items.title: Dubai Holding awards Dh5bn contracts for new HQ and Jumeirah Residences Emirates Towers
items.summary: Dubai Holding awarded China State Construction (CSCEC ME) Dh5bn of contracts for its SOM-designed circular headquarters, due 2029, and Jumeirah Residences Emirates Towers. The latter comprises 754 branded residences across two SCDA-designed towers, with handover scheduled for 2030.

items.title: Dubai home values slip 3.1% year-on-year in August as sales volumes cool
items.summary: ValuStrat's index fell 0.2% in August to 218.8 points, down 3.1% annually and 10.2% below February's peak. Villas dipped 1.7% year-on-year, the first annual fall since 2021, while apartments eased 5.3%. Ready sales fell 20.6% and off-plan registrations 40.4% year-on-year.

items.title: PIF launches Gulf Coast Development Company for 20 sq km Al-Khafji destination
items.summary: PIF set up Gulf Coast Development Company to build an integrated coastal destination in Al-Khafji, Eastern Province, spanning about 20 sq km with a 10 km Gulf waterfront. Plans include eight neighbourhoods with 16,000+ homes, roughly 1,400 hotel rooms and marinas; phase one is due in 2030.
